llm.summary: This is a prompt-only bag comfort audit skill with clear health safety boundaries and no executable, network, credential, or persistence behavior.

dimensions.detail: The requested environment impact is proportionate to the purpose because the skill only guides conversational collection and organization of bag-carry information.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The manifest declares a prompt-only, document-only skill with no executable code, no API requirement, no network access, and no credential use; the artifact directory contains only SKILL.md, skill.json, and ACCEPTANCE.md.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are constrained to user-provided bag, contents, carry-duration, discomfort, and constraint information, with explicit non-diagnostic and medical-escalation boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background process, memory-writing, tool modification, or credential/session/profile handling is present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's instructions match its stated purpose: inventory bag contents, estimate weight, check fit and balance, create a repacking plan, and route severe or persistent symptoms to medical care without diagnosing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill gives practical organization and comfort guidance for bags, not medical advice. Users with severe pain, numbness, weakness, injury signs, or persistent symptoms should seek qualified medical evaluation rather than relying on the audit.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The cited English-only criterion appears in ACCEPTANCE.md as package/content acceptance metadata for an English-language prompt-only skill, not as a runtime instruction to override user language preferences; it does not create a security or Review concern.
